description.value: Snow Creek Lodge is a ski-in/ski-out luxury condo property at Fernie Alpine Resort, constructed in 1999 and situated directly beside the Elk Quad chairlift. It offers 61 studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites with fireplaces, access to two hot tubs, an outdoor heated pool, a fitness room, and underground parking. Managed by Fernie Lodging Company, it is one of the operator's flagship 'Signature Properties' in the Elk Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms Snow Creek Lodge is a real, operating ski-in/ski-out condo property at Fernie Alpine Resort managed by Fernie Lodging Co. The about-us page explicitly describes 61 luxury suites, outdoor heated pool, 2 hot tubs, fitness room, and underground parking. Ski lockers are listed as an amenity on every individual unit listing, and OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is supported by the FAQ's 'Internet and Telephones' topic heading. No explicit bike storage, bike-specific services, laundry, or breakfast are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address is '5258 Highline Drive' (the lodge location) but the website's contact page only lists '4559-B Timberline Crescent, Fernie, BC V0B 1M6', which appears to be the Fernie Lodging Company management office, not the lodge itself — lodge street address is unconfirmed by the website.

Property is ski-resort-focused; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, wash, tools) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Ski lockers and underground parking exist but are not described in terms usable by cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating ski resort accommodation with active booking listings; a valid lodging option for touring cyclists visiting the Fernie Alpine Resort area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Snow Creek Lodge is one of several properties managed by Fernie Lodging Company under the same phone number and website domain. The ski lockers (listed per unit) and underground parking could theoretically accommodate bicycles, but no explicit cyclist provisions are stated.

wow_evidence: outdoor heated pool, 2 hot tubs...Fernie Lodging Company...flagship 'Signature Properties'

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Newer slope-side condos w/ pool + hot tubs, ~$200-300 in season
